decks.notes: This deck utilizes aggressive Rakdos creatures and disruptive spells to put pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the board. It combines efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt with hand disruption like Thoughtseize to keep the opponent off-balance. The deck also includes powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Grief to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for card advantage in a fast-paced aggro strategy, while cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Not Dead After All offer resilience to removal. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing powerful early game threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to put pressure on the opponent. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the board while disruption cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Terminate deal with threats effectively. The deck also has synergy with graveyard interactions, utilizing cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Liliana of the Veil to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression while maintaining control of the board.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to play Primeval Titan and search for combo pieces such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The One Ring. Using cards like Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens to generate extra mana and untap lands, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful land combos and massive creatures. By utilizing cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to play multiple lands per turn, the deck can quickly assemble its win conditions and overwhelm opponents in a single explosive turn.

The main focus of this Modern Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to control the board. Additionally, Angrath's Rampage and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional disruption and value. The deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while maintaining control over the game through a combination of aggro and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently by untapping lands that enter the battlefield. This allows the player to quickly play out powerful cards like Primeval Titan and cultists, creating a swarm of threats that overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Tolaria West to search for key pieces of the combo. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to create a lethal board state and win the game in a single turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing the unique abilities of cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and The One Ring to generate powerful combinations and ramp into big threats quickly. By using the land bounce effects of cards like Simic Growth Chamber and Selesnya Sanctuary, the deck can create explosive turns where it can search for specific lands and set up powerful board states. With the right sequence of plays, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and establish a dominant position on the battlefield.

The deck utilizes a variety of low-cost creatures and combo pieces to create a versatile toolbox of options for different situations. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck can quickly assemble powerful combinations to overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of Grist, the Hunger Tide and Agatha's Soul Cauldron allows for recursion and additional value generation. With a mix of creature threats, removal, and recursion, the deck can adapt to different matchups and win conditions, making it a flexible and resilient choice for Modern 1 vs 1 games.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist. It also utilizes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Faithful Mending to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and hand disruption to protect its combo pieces and maintain tempo. With strong card advantage engines and versatile instant-speed reanimation options, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively building up your board presence with efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf, Monastery Swiftspear, and Questing Druid. Utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to clear a path for your creatures while also applying pressure to your opponent. Mishra's Bauble provides card advantage and deck manipulation. The inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for potential graveyard recursion to keep up the pressure. The deck also includes ways to fix your mana base with fetch lands and card draw with Abundant Harvest.

The deck focuses on using cards like Grief, Subtlety, and Living End to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board. By cycling through cards like Architects of Will and Street Wraith, the deck aims to fill its graveyard with creatures to then cascade into a game-winning Living End. Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation provide additional disruption and protection for the combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and take control of the game through the Living End combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful control spells and disruptive creatures. The key strategy involves using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to manipulate the board state and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. Cards like Solitude and Supreme Verdict provide removal options, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recursion. The win condition typically involves overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through attrition.

This Modern 1 vs 1 deck focuses on utilizing Humans with strong synergy to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. Aether Vial and Ancient Ziggurat help with mana acceleration, while cards like Champion of the Parish, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Imperial Recruiter boost the power and toughness of Human creatures on the battlefield. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Esper Sentinel and Unsettled Mariner help control the board, while Jirina, Dauntless General provides additional utility and Norin the Wary adds an element of unpredictability to keep opponents off balance.

The deck focuses on utilizing a diverse range of multi-colored creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By incorporating cards with varying colors and abilities, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and maintain board control through a combination of creature aggression and targeted removal. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring allows for additional flexibility in casting spells while leveraging the unique abilities of the deck's composition. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan in a fast-paced, aggressive manner.

The main concept of this Amulet Titan combo deck is to generate a powerful board presence quickly by leveraging the synergy between Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and various lands that produce multiple mana or have additional land abilities. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly, search for key lands with Primeval Titan, and eventually overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful land triggers and creature abilities. The deck utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Explore to accelerate its game plan and efficiently assemble the necessary resources for a lethal attack.

The deck focuses on using a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a powerful toolbox, allowing the player to adapt to different situations and opponents. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Agatha's Soul Cauldron, the player can search for specific creatures needed for combos or to control the board. Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician provide additional value through sacrificing creatures and generating advantage. Overall, the deck aims to combo off with its creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to establish early board presence with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while utilizing efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to keep the pressure on the opponent. Dragon's Rage Channeler serves as a powerful threat that grows as the game progresses. The deck also has access to powerful card advantage engines like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, helping to ensure a steady stream of threats and answers. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and flexibility as a companion option.
